digest.component_or_area: Quality remediation audit; CI, documentation, module size/complexity/typing
propositions: CI default-suite reliability flake causes Python 3.11 xdist worker failure in test_opcert_service_app and must be root-caused with durable fix
User-facing assignee documentation example drifts from config.md guidance and does not teach Jira-resolvable identity consistently
Near-cap modules structured_run.py, compact.py, and event_append.py exceed safe size thresholds due to mixed responsibilities and lack separation of concerns
Graph loader/traversal infrastructure is duplicated across _blockers and _compute_dep_graph functions, driving high cyclomatic complexity in blocker subsystem
Attest package lacks complete type annotation coverage under strict mypy checking mode (--disallow-untyped-defs)
Ratchet enforcement at hard caps lacks early-warning margins to surface creep before thresholds are breached
